cases.name: Katy Lynne Dougherty
cases.about:
She was a hairdresser for local assisted living communities and was known to care for residents.

Her obituary said, "Katy's light always shined bright; she lit up any room she came into. Her smile was infectious. She loved her family and Coco, her cat. She was funny, giving, giggly and witty. She loved her job as a hair stylist; it filled her soul. She was an artist and she loved music and really got down to the beat. She considered her friends as though they were family. Family was everything to Katy. She was truly loved because she was love!"
cases.narrative: He allegedly beat her to death with a wrench while she was asleep on the couch.
